contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI ; D/ D N GRATIANVS AVGG AVG

A copper-alloy Nummus of Gratian, AD367-383. Mint is Arles, AD367-375 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI. Reverse shows Emperor standing holding standard and shield. See RIC IX, no.15. Obverse legend reads D N GRATIANVS AVGG AVG. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: OF/III//[...]. Die axis is 12 o'clock.
